segments.text: What you pour on Shiva decides what you get, not a splash.
The Shiva Purana says, a stream that never breaks.
Water, in a stream, it eases fever.
With sugar, a mind as sharp as Brhaspati, the Guru of the Gods.
And one more, it defeats enemies.
Only one gives you the joys of this life, and Moksha, Gangajal.
With every stream, the Mahamrityun chair mantra, ten thousand times.
Which one will you pour? Comment.
Next, do your Diwali Aarti with this reel.
Follow, so you do not miss it.
